intro: A recovered statuette was meant for Menethil Harbor before tragedy interrupted its delivery. You are asked to bring it to Captain Stoutfist at Menethil Keep.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Blind Princess was to deliver this to Menethil Harbor before tragedy struck. We were so close!
I believe it was to be signed for by Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Keep just behind us. Why don't you do the honors of finishing the job?
